description: Create anonymous one-off Checkout after an estimate, explicit human link-creation approval and lawful-basis confirmation. Read analysis_options.checkout. The human reviews the hosted upfront amount and pays; it can exceed analysis cost. Save job_id, payment_url and continuation.review_url privately; lost links require support, not a replacement purchase. For minimum_charge_offer, show minimum final cost and upfront estimate, obtain explicit acceptance, then send accept_minimum_charge:true and max_upfront_amount_cents at the approved ceiling. Rights alone do not approve spending. On estimate_pricing_changed, get a fresh free estimate and explicit approval. An exceeded cap needs new review; never raise it or retry automatically. Poll the original job with get_job_status after payment or interruption. Host setup/recovery: https://pulse.studiosphere.space/connect

accept_minimum_charge.description: Optional. Set true only after explicit human acceptance of minimum_charge_offer.minimum_final_cost_usd and its estimated upfront payment. Rights confirmation alone is not spending approval.

attestation_confirmed.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has confirmed they have rights, permission, lawful access, or another legal basis to submit this audio, or the current user-requested batch/folder/project containing it, for analysis.

max_upfront_amount_cents.description: Optional approved upfront USD ceiling in whole cents; required for minimum-charge acceptance. The gateway rejects a higher charge before creating a purchase. Do not raise it without renewed human approval.

name: request_payment_link

continuation.description: Advisory saved-job recovery. URLs contain a private job reference. No provider read or settlement verification is performed.

deduped.description: True when an existing active Checkout link was reused.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the Checkout link expires.

job_id.description: Pulse job id for polling after payment.

payment_url.description: Stripe Checkout URL to present to the user.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry after changing state or waiting.
